b16924359.desc:
This 3-bedroom residential apartment in Residences Du Port Autograph Collection Residences in Al Majara, Dubai Marina is offered for sale. The home provides a practical layout with open-plan living and dining areas, multiple bathrooms, and private outdoor space. Large windows frame marina and city skyline views, while modern finishes and furnished interiors support comfortable day-to-day use. 
Key Features:
• 3 Bedrooms
• 4 Bathrooms
• Furnished interiors
• Open-plan living layout
• Primary bedroom suite
• Multiple modern bathrooms
• Balcony or terrace
• Marina and skyline views
• Downtown city views
• Pool view
Amenities:
• Swimming pool
• Kids play area
• Lawn or garden
• Gym or health club
• Business center
• Lobby in building
• Private cinema
• Valet service
• Pet-friendly community
• CCTV security
• 24-hour concierge
• Covered parking
The apartment benefits from shared pool decks and landscaped outdoor areas with loungers, shaded seating and views over the marina canal. Indoor facilities include a wellness-focused gym with cardio and weights, community health club access and spa-style features within the wider Al Majara setting. Living spaces and bedrooms are designed with floor-to-ceiling windows to maximise natural light and outlook. 
The wider Al Majara community offers landscaped courtyards, an indoor kids’ play area, barbecue zones and a community centre with business facilities and a coffee shop. Residents have access to a resort-style pool, sauna, steam room and Jacuzzi, along with dedicated maintenance staff and gated, key-card building access. Parking spaces and high-speed elevators serve residents and visitors efficiently. 
Located in Dubai Marina along the waterfront near Dubai Marina Yacht Club, the property provides direct access to the marina promenade and dining on Marina Walk. Sheikh Zayed Road is close by, supporting convenient travel to Dubai Internet City, Media City and Emirates Golf Club. DMCC Metro Station and other public transport links are within easy reach, and Dubai Marina Mall and nearby schools and hospitals are accessible in a short drive.
